gameName: Unicorn Glitterluck: A Party for Rosalie
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently dreamed about a unicorn may begin.
officialTieBreak: If the players cannot agree, the youngest player begins.
clarifications: The starter rolls the die first; turns continue clockwise.
